run_pass_through_coverage_check: run the pass through code coverage check to find untested functions in litellm proxy handlers
extract_function_names_from_file: extract all function and method names from a Python source file using AST parsing
find_called_functions_in_tests: find all pass through handler methods called within test files in a given directory
compare_router_functions_to_tests: compare functions defined in a router file against those called in tests to identify gaps
review_pass_through_coverage_script: review the pass through code coverage script that analyzes test coverage for litellm proxy handler classes
